Tests bloom filter sizing, insert/contains, and key bounds behavior.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test program for the `fd_bloom` Bloom filter implementation. It checks compile-time layout rules with `FD_STATIC_ASSERT`, then verifies filter sizing, initialization, insertion, and membership tests with [`test_filters`](<#test_filters>) and [`test_add_contains`](<#test_add_contains>). The [`test_keys_oob`](<#test_keys_oob>) function checks that the `keys` region does not overlap the filter `bits` region when the filter is configured for a very low false positive rate. The [`main`](<#main>) function starts the test runtime, runs each test, and logs a notice after each one passes.
